senses.en: for a period of time with no fixed end
in a vague or unclear way

ex.en: The concert has been postponed indefinitely because of the storm.
ex.zh: 由於暴風雨，演唱會無限期延後。

root.note: 沒有界限地 → 無限期地

senses.en: impossible to remove or erase

ex.en: Her first trip abroad left an indelible impression on her.
ex.zh: 她第一次出國旅行留下了難以磨滅的印象。

parts.m: destroy, blot out 抹去（同 delete）

root.note: 無法抹去的

senses.en: too extreme or unusual to be described

ex.en: The joy of holding her newborn son was indescribable.
ex.zh: 抱著剛出生的兒子，那種喜悅難以形容。

root.note: 無法寫下來的 → 難以形容的

senses.en: not able to be destroyed
senses.zh: 不可毀滅的；堅不可摧的

ex.en: These plastic toys seem almost indestructible.
ex.zh: 這些塑膠玩具似乎幾乎摔不壞。

root.note: 無法拆毀的

senses.en: something that indicates or points out; an indicator

ex.en: Rising prices are often an indicant of a strong economy.
ex.zh: 物價上漲常是經濟強勁的指標。

root.note: 指出事情的東西 → 指標

senses.en: a sign that shows the condition or existence of something
a device such as a gauge or light that shows information

ex.en: Unemployment is an important indicator of economic health.
ex.zh: 失業率是經濟健康的重要指標。

root.note: 指出狀況的東西 → 指標

senses.en: to formally charge someone with a serious crime
to strongly criticize

ex.en: The grand jury voted to indict the company's former CEO for fraud.
ex.zh: 大陪審團投票決定以詐欺罪起訴該公司的前執行長。

root.note: 對某人宣告罪名 → 起訴

mn: c 不發音，唸起來像 in-DITE。

senses.en: extreme poverty

ex.en: The novel describes a family's slide from wealth into indigence.
ex.zh: 這部小說描寫一個家庭從富裕淪為貧困的過程。

parts.m: in 在內（古拉丁文 indu）

root.note: 處於匱乏之中 → 貧困

senses.en: originating or living naturally in a particular place; native
senses.zh: 本土的；原生的；原住民的

ex.en: The museum displays art made by indigenous peoples of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 這間博物館展示臺灣原住民族的藝術作品。

root.note: 在當地出生的 → 本土的

mn: 別和 indigent（貧窮的）搞混：indigenous 多了 -ous，意思是「本土的」。

senses.en: very poor; needy
a needy person

ex.en: The clinic provides free care to indigent patients.
ex.zh: 這間診所為貧困病患提供免費醫療。

root.note: 處於匱乏之中的 → 貧窮的

senses.en: difficult or impossible to digest
hard to understand or accept
senses.zh: 難以理解的；難以接受的

ex.en: Raw beans can be indigestible for many people.
ex.zh: 生豆子對許多人來說很難消化。

root.note: 無法分解帶走的 → 難消化的

senses.en: pain or discomfort in the stomach after eating

ex.en: Eating too fast can give you indigestion.
ex.zh: 吃太快會讓你消化不良。

root.note: 無法消化 → 消化不良

senses.en: angry because of unfair treatment

ex.en: She was indignant when the store refused to honor the warranty.
ex.zh: 店家拒絕履行保固，讓她很憤慨。

root.note: 認為受到不值得的對待 → 憤慨的

senses.en: treatment that makes someone feel ashamed or lose respect

ex.en: He suffered the indignity of being searched in front of his coworkers.
ex.zh: 他當著同事的面被搜身，受盡屈辱。

root.note: 不尊重 → 侮辱

senses.en: impossible to see or clearly distinguish

ex.en: The difference between the two copies was almost indiscernible.
ex.zh: 這兩份複本的差異幾乎看不出來。

root.note: 無法區分開的 → 難以辨別的

senses.en: careless about revealing secrets or saying embarrassing things
senses.zh: 輕率的；不謹慎的；口風不緊的

ex.en: An indiscreet comment on social media cost him his job.
ex.zh: 他在社群媒體上一句不謹慎的留言害他丟了工作。

root.note: 不懂得分辨該說什麼 → 輕率的

senses.en: done without careful judgment or choice; random
senses.zh: 不加區別的；隨意的；濫用的

ex.en: The indiscriminate use of antibiotics has created resistant bacteria.
ex.zh: 濫用抗生素已經造成抗藥性細菌。

root.note: 不加區分的

senses.en: absolutely necessary

ex.en: A good dictionary is indispensable for learning a new language.
ex.zh: 學新語言時，一本好字典是不可或缺的。

root.note: 不能分發出去、省掉的 → 不可或缺的

senses.en: not clear or sharp; hard to see or hear

ex.en: Through the fog, the shape of the boat was indistinct.
ex.zh: 透過濃霧，船的輪廓模糊不清。

root.note: 沒有清楚標記的 → 模糊的

senses.en: not able to be turned aside or diverted
senses.zh: 無法轉移的；無法避開的

ex.en: The river's course proved indivertible despite the engineers' efforts.
ex.zh: 儘管工程師們努力，河道還是無法改道。

root.note: 無法轉向一旁的

senses.en: unable to be divided or separated
(math) unable to be divided without a remainder

ex.en: The founders believed that the nation should be one and indivisible.
ex.zh: 建國者們相信國家應該是統一而不可分割的。

root.note: 無法分開的

senses.en: laziness; avoidance of activity or effort

ex.en: His failure was due more to indolence than to lack of talent.
ex.zh: 他的失敗與其說是缺乏天分，不如說是懶惰。

root.note: 不想吃苦 → 懶惰

senses.en: lazy; wanting to avoid activity or effort
(medicine) causing little or no pain; slow to develop

ex.en: The indolent cat spent the whole afternoon sleeping in the sun.
ex.zh: 那隻懶貓整個下午都在曬太陽睡覺。

root.note: 不想吃苦的 → 懶惰的

senses.en: impossible to defeat or discourage
senses.zh: 不屈不撓的；不可征服的

ex.en: The injured runner showed indomitable courage by finishing the race.
ex.zh: 受傷的跑者展現不屈不撓的勇氣，跑完了全程。

root.note: 無法被馴服的 → 不屈不撓的

senses.en: to formally admit someone to a position or organization
to enlist someone for military service

ex.en: The club will induct five new members at tonight's ceremony.
ex.zh: 這個社團將在今晚的典禮上正式接納五名新成員。

root.note: 引領進入 → 使入會、就職

senses.en: the act of allowing oneself to enjoy a pleasure
something enjoyed as a special treat
tolerance or leniency

ex.en: A hot bath after work is my favorite indulgence.
ex.zh: 下班後泡個熱水澡是我最愛的享受。

root.note: 對自己或他人寬容 → 放縱

senses.en: allowing someone to have or do whatever they want

ex.en: The indulgent grandparents let the kids eat candy before dinner.
ex.zh: 寵孫的祖父母讓孩子們在晚餐前吃糖。

root.note: 非常寬容的 → 縱容的

senses.en: to make someone drunk
[ɪnˋibrɪɪt] a drunken person

ex.en: Just two glasses of wine were enough to inebriate him.
ex.zh: 兩杯葡萄酒就足以讓他喝醉。

root.note: 使喝醉

senses.en: not fit or safe to eat

ex.en: The burnt cookies were completely inedible.
ex.zh: 那些烤焦的餅乾完全不能吃。

root.note: 不能吃的

senses.en: too great or extreme to be expressed in words

ex.en: They stood in ineffable wonder at the edge of the Grand Canyon.
ex.zh: 他們站在大峽谷邊緣，心中有種難以言喻的驚嘆。

root.note: 無法說出口的 → 難以言喻的

senses.en: failure to use time, energy, or resources well

ex.en: The report blamed the delays on inefficiency in the shipping department.
ex.zh: 報告把延誤歸咎於運輸部門的效率低落。

root.note: 做不出成果 → 效率低

senses.en: not using time, energy, or resources well

ex.en: Old light bulbs are inefficient because they waste energy as heat.
ex.zh: 舊式燈泡效率很低，因為它們把能量浪費在發熱上。

root.note: 做不出成果的 → 效率低的

senses.en: not qualified or allowed to do or receive something

ex.en: Students with failing grades are ineligible to play on the team.
ex.zh: 成績不及格的學生沒有資格參加校隊比賽。

root.note: 不能被選出的 → 不合格的

senses.en: having no skill; clumsy

ex.en: I am completely inept at fixing anything electrical.
ex.zh: 我對修理任何電器都完全不在行。

root.note: 不適合、不得要領的 → 笨拙的

mn: inept（笨拙）和 adept（熟練）正好相反。

senses.en: lacking the ability or strength to move
(chemistry) not reacting with other substances

ex.en: Helium is an inert gas that does not easily react with other elements.
ex.zh: 氦是一種不易與其他元素反應的惰性氣體。

root.note: 沒有技藝、不會動 → 不動的

senses.en: too great to be calculated or measured

ex.en: Her mentor's advice was of inestimable value to her career.
ex.zh: 導師的建議對她的職業生涯有無可估量的價值。

root.note: 無法估價的

senses.en: certain to happen; unavoidable

ex.en: With so many injured players, the team's defeat seemed inevitable.
ex.zh: 受傷的球員那麼多，球隊輸球似乎是必然的。

root.note: 無法避開的

senses.en: too bad to be excused or forgiven

ex.en: Leaving a dog in a hot car is inexcusable.
ex.zh: 把狗留在悶熱的車裡是不可原諒的。

root.note: 無法免除罪責的 → 不可原諒的

senses.en: never running out; unlimited

ex.en: The toddler seemed to have an inexhaustible supply of energy.
ex.zh: 那個小孩似乎有用不完的精力。

root.note: 汲取不完的

senses.en: impossible to stop or prevent
senses.zh: 無法阻擋的；不可避免的

senses.en: (of a person) unable to be persuaded

ex.en: Nothing could halt the inexorable rise of sea levels.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼能阻止海平面無可阻擋的上升。

root.note: 怎麼求都求不動的 → 無法阻擋的

senses.en: not practical or wise in a particular situation

ex.en: The advisers felt it was inexpedient to raise taxes before the election.
ex.zh: 顧問們認為在選前加稅並不明智。

root.note: 無法讓腳脫困的 → 不便、不得策的

senses.en: not costing a lot of money

ex.en: We found an inexpensive hotel close to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們找到一家靠近海灘又不貴的旅館。

root.note: 不必付出很多的 → 便宜的

senses.en: lack of knowledge or skill gained from experience

ex.en: The young driver's inexperience showed on the icy road.
ex.zh: 在結冰的路面上，那位年輕駕駛缺乏經驗就顯露出來了。

root.note: 沒有嘗試過 → 缺乏經驗

senses.en: impossible to explain or understand

ex.en: For some inexplicable reason, the printer stopped working.
ex.zh: 不知道什麼原因，印表機就是不動了。

root.note: 無法展開說明的 → 無法解釋的

senses.en: too strong to be put into words
senses.zh: 無法言喻的；難以表達的

ex.en: The family felt inexpressible relief when the lost child was found.
ex.zh: 走失的孩子被找到時，家人感到無法言喻的寬慰。

root.note: 無法壓出、說出的 → 無法言喻的

senses.en: not able to be stretched or extended
senses.zh: 不能伸展的；無伸縮性的

ex.en: The cable is made of an inextensible fiber that will not stretch under load.
ex.zh: 這條纜繩由無伸縮性的纖維製成，受力時不會拉長。

root.note: 無法向外伸展的

senses.en: never wrong or never failing
senses.zh: 絕不會錯的；萬無一失的

ex.en: No test is infallible, so doctors often order a second one.
ex.zh: 沒有任何檢驗是絕對不會出錯的，所以醫生常會要求再驗一次。

root.note: 不會犯錯的

senses.en: well known for something bad
senses.zh: 惡名昭彰的；聲名狼藉的

ex.en: The prison was infamous for its harsh conditions.
ex.zh: 那座監獄以條件惡劣而惡名昭彰。

root.note: 沒有好名聲的 → 惡名昭彰的

mn: 重音在第一音節 IN-famous，不是「不出名」而是「出壞名」。

senses.en: the state of being known for something very bad
a shocking or evil act

ex.en: The general's betrayal brought him lasting infamy.
ex.zh: 那位將軍的背叛讓他永遠背負惡名。

root.note: 壞名聲 → 惡名

senses.en: a conclusion reached from evidence and reasoning

ex.en: From the wet streets, the logical inference was that it had rained.
ex.zh: 從潮濕的街道，合理的推論是剛才下過雨。

root.note: 把證據帶進來得出結論 → 推論

senses.en: relating to hell or the underworld
(informal) extremely annoying

ex.en: Please turn off that infernal alarm!
ex.zh: 拜託把那個吵死人的鬧鐘關掉！

root.note: 在底下的世界 → 地獄的

senses.en: (of insects or animals) to be present in large, harmful numbers

ex.en: Termites can infest a wooden house without anyone noticing.
ex.zh: 白蟻可能在沒人察覺的情況下侵擾木造房屋。

parts.m: hostile 有敵意的（拉丁文 infestus）

root.note: 敵意地侵擾 → 大量出沒

senses.en: (old use, offensive) a person who does not believe in a particular religion

ex.en: In the medieval epic, the knight rides out to fight the infidel.
ex.zh: 在這部中世紀史詩中，騎士出征去攻打異教徒。

root.note: 沒有（正統）信仰的人 → 異教徒

senses.en: the act of being unfaithful to a partner
lack of religious belief

ex.en: The novel explores how infidelity destroys a marriage.
ex.zh: 這部小說探討外遇如何摧毀一段婚姻。

root.note: 不忠誠 → 不忠

senses.en: without limits in space, time, or amount
very great

ex.en: A kindergarten teacher needs infinite patience.
ex.zh: 幼兒園老師需要無比的耐心。

root.note: 沒有盡頭的 → 無限的

mn: 發音是 IN-fi-nit，最後不唸 night。

senses.en: the state or quality of having no end or limit

ex.en: The road seemed to stretch into infinity across the desert.
ex.zh: 那條路彷彿穿越沙漠無限延伸。

root.note: 沒有盡頭 → 無限

senses.en: physically weak, especially because of age or illness

ex.en: The volunteers deliver meals to elderly and infirm residents.
ex.zh: 志工為年長和體弱的居民送餐。

root.note: 不堅固的 → 虛弱的

senses.en: a place where sick or injured people are cared for, as in a school

ex.en: The student felt dizzy and went to the school infirmary.
ex.zh: 那個學生覺得頭暈，就去了學校保健室。

root.note: 照顧虛弱者的地方 → 醫務室

senses.en: physical or mental weakness, often caused by age

ex.en: Despite the infirmity of old age, he still walked to the market every day.
ex.zh: 儘管年老體衰，他仍然每天走路去市場。

root.note: 不強健 → 虛弱

senses.en: easily set on fire
easily angered or excited

ex.en: Keep inflammable liquids away from the stove.
ex.zh: 易燃液體要遠離爐子。

root.note: 能進入燃燒狀態的 → 易燃的

mn: inflammable 的 in- 不是「不」！它和 flammable 同義，都是「易燃的」。

senses.en: a condition in which part of the body becomes red, swollen, hot, and painful

ex.en: Ice can help reduce the inflammation in your knee.
ex.zh: 冰敷可以幫助減輕你膝蓋的發炎。

root.note: 身體像著火般紅熱 → 發炎

senses.en: unwilling to change or compromise
not able to bend

ex.en: The school's inflexible rules left no room for special cases.
ex.zh: 這所學校的規定毫無彈性，完全不容許特例。

root.note: 不能彎曲的

senses.en: the power to affect people or events
to have an effect on someone or something

ex.en: Parents have a strong influence on their children's eating habits.
ex.zh: 父母對孩子的飲食習慣有很大的影響。

root.note: 流入（人心）的力量 → 影響

senses.en: having great influence on someone or something

ex.en: She was one of the most influential scientists of her generation.
ex.zh: 她是她那一代最有影響力的科學家之一。

root.note: 有影響力的

senses.en: the arrival of a large number of people or things

ex.en: The town struggled to handle the influx of tourists in summer.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮難以應付夏天大量湧入的遊客。

root.note: 流進來 → 湧入

senses.en: the state of rarely happening

ex.en: The infrequence of rain in the region makes farming difficult.
ex.zh: 這個地區很少下雨，所以務農很困難。

root.note: 不頻繁 → 稀少

senses.en: not happening often

ex.en: Buses to the village are infrequent, so check the schedule.
ex.zh: 開往那個村子的公車班次很少，記得先查時刻表。

root.note: 不頻繁的

senses.en: to break a law or agreement
to limit or undermine something

ex.en: Copying the song without permission would infringe copyright law.
ex.zh: 未經許可翻唱這首歌會侵犯著作權法。

root.note: 闖入打破 → 違反

senses.en: to fill someone or something with a quality or feeling
to soak tea or herbs in liquid to extract flavor

ex.en: The new coach tried to infuse the team with confidence.
ex.zh: 新教練試著讓球隊充滿自信。

root.note: 倒進去 → 注入

senses.en: the introduction of something new into a situation
a drink made by soaking leaves or herbs in hot water
(medicine) a slow injection of fluid into a vein

ex.en: The business survived thanks to an infusion of cash from investors.
ex.zh: 這家公司靠著投資人注入的資金才撐了下來。

root.note: 倒進去 → 注入

senses.en: clever, original, and inventive

ex.en: She came up with an ingenious way to keep the cat off the table.
ex.zh: 她想出一個巧妙的方法讓貓不跳上桌。

root.note: 天生有才能的 → 巧妙的

mn: ingenious（聰明巧妙）vs. ingenuous（天真坦率）：多了 i 的比較聰明。

senses.en: the quality of being clever, original, and inventive

ex.en: With a little ingenuity, you can turn old jars into lamps.
ex.zh: 只要一點巧思，你就能把舊罐子變成燈。

root.note: 天生的才智 → 巧思

senses.en: innocent, trusting, and honest, sometimes too much so

ex.en: His ingenuous smile made it hard to believe he could lie.
ex.zh: 他天真的笑容讓人很難相信他會說謊。

root.note: 原指「生來自由的」→ 坦率、天真的

mn: ingenuous（天真）vs. ingenious（聰明）：注意中間的 u 和 i。

senses.en: causing shame; not glorious

ex.en: The army made an inglorious retreat under cover of darkness.
ex.zh: 軍隊趁著夜色狼狽撤退。

root.note: 不光榮的

senses.en: (variant of engraft) to graft a plant part onto another; to implant firmly

ex.en: The gardener tried to ingraft a pear branch onto the old tree.
ex.zh: 園丁試著把梨樹枝嫁接到老樹上。

root.note: 嫁接進去

senses.en: to try to gain someone's favor, often by flattery

ex.en: He tried to ingratiate himself with the new boss by bringing her coffee.
ex.zh: 他幫新老闆帶咖啡，試圖討好她。

root.note: 讓自己進入別人的好感中 → 討好

senses.en: lack of thankfulness

ex.en: She was hurt by her friend's ingratitude after all her help.
ex.zh: 她幫了朋友那麼多，朋友卻不知感恩，讓她很受傷。

root.note: 不感激

senses.en: one of the foods or substances combined to make a dish or product
an element that contributes to something

ex.en: Trust is the key ingredient in any successful friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是任何成功友誼中最重要的要素。

root.note: 走進（成品）裡的東西 → 成分

senses.en: the state of being a natural, permanent part of something

ex.en: Philosophers debated the inherence of beauty in the objects themselves.
ex.zh: 哲學家們辯論美是否固有於事物本身。

root.note: 黏在裡面 → 固有

senses.en: existing as a natural, basic part of something

ex.en: There are inherent risks in any extreme sport.
ex.zh: 任何極限運動都有其固有的風險。

root.note: 黏在裡面的 → 固有的

senses.en: to hinder, restrain, or prevent an action or process
to make someone feel too self-conscious to act naturally

ex.en: Some medicines inhibit the growth of bacteria.
ex.zh: 有些藥物能抑制細菌生長。

root.note: 把它握住不放出 → 抑制

senses.en: (of a place) harsh and difficult to live in
unfriendly to guests

ex.en: Antarctica is one of the most inhospitable places on Earth.
ex.zh: 南極洲是地球上最不適合居住的地方之一。

root.note: 不善待客人的 → 不好客、不宜居的

senses.en: extremely cruel
not human in nature or appearance

ex.en: The prisoners were held in inhuman conditions.
ex.zh: 囚犯被關在不人道的環境中。

root.note: 沒有人性的 → 殘忍的

senses.en: (formal) to bury a dead body

ex.en: The family chose to inhume the remains in the village cemetery.
ex.zh: 家屬選擇把遺體葬在村裡的墓地。

root.note: 放進土裡 → 埋葬

senses.en: harmful or tending to obstruct
unfriendly; hostile

ex.en: High taxes can be inimical to small businesses.
ex.zh: 高稅率可能對小型企業不利。

root.note: 不是朋友的 → 有敵意的、有害的

senses.en: great injustice or immoral behavior

ex.en: The preacher warned his congregation against iniquity and greed.
ex.zh: 傳道人告誡會眾要遠離罪惡與貪婪。

root.note: 不公平 → 不公正；罪惡

mn: 常見片語 den of iniquity：罪惡的淵藪。

senses.en: to cause a process or action to begin
to admit someone into a group, often with a ceremony
[ɪˋnɪʃɪɪt] a person who has been newly admitted to a group

ex.en: The city plans to initiate a new recycling program next year.
ex.zh: 市政府計畫明年開始一項新的回收計畫。

root.note: 走進去 → 開始

senses.en: to put a liquid such as a drug into the body with a needle
to introduce a new quality into something

ex.en: The new manager tried to inject some fun into the weekly meetings.
ex.zh: 新經理試著為每週會議注入一些樂趣。

root.note: 投進去 → 注射；注入

senses.en: a court order requiring someone to do or stop doing something
an authoritative warning or order

ex.en: A judge issued an injunction to stop the construction.
ex.zh: 法官發出禁制令，要求停止施工。

root.note: 把命令加到某人身上 → 禁制令

senses.en: a slight suspicion or hint

ex.en: I had no inkling that they were planning a surprise party.
ex.zh: 我完全沒察覺他們在籌劃驚喜派對。

mn: 常見句型：have no inkling（毫無頭緒、完全沒察覺）。

senses.en: located away from the coast
toward or in the interior of a country

ex.en: The storm moved inland and weakened over the mountains.
ex.zh: 暴風雨移入內陸，在山區減弱。

root.note: 在陸地裡面 → 內陸

senses.en: a narrow strip of water that goes into the land from a sea or lake
an opening through which something enters

ex.en: We anchored our boat in a quiet inlet for the night.
ex.zh: 我們把船停泊在一處寧靜的小海灣過夜。

root.note: 讓水進來的地方 → 水灣

senses.en: deepest or most private; innermost

ex.en: She wrote her inmost thoughts in a diary that no one else read.
ex.zh: 她把內心最深處的想法寫在沒人看過的日記裡。

root.note: 最裡面的

senses.en: not harmful or offensive

ex.en: What seemed like an innocuous joke deeply hurt her feelings.
ex.zh: 一個看似無傷大雅的玩笑，卻深深傷了她的心。

root.note: 不傷害的 → 無害的

senses.en: to introduce new methods, ideas, or products

ex.en: Companies must innovate to stay ahead of their competitors.
ex.zh: 企業必須創新才能領先競爭對手。

root.note: 帶入新的東西 → 創新

senses.en: an indirect remark suggesting something bad or rude

ex.en: The article was full of innuendo but offered no real evidence.
ex.zh: 這篇文章充滿影射，卻沒有提出任何真正的證據。

root.note: 點頭示意 → 暗示、影射

senses.en: too many to be counted

ex.en: On a clear night, innumerable stars fill the sky.
ex.zh: 晴朗的夜裡，無數星星布滿天空。

root.note: 數不清的

senses.en: not likely to upset or offend anyone

ex.en: He was a quiet, inoffensive man who kept to himself.
ex.zh: 他是個安靜、與人無爭的人，不太跟人來往。

root.note: 不冒犯人的

senses.en: happening at an inconvenient or bad time
senses.zh: 不合時宜的；時機不對的

ex.en: The phone rang at an inopportune moment, right in the middle of the exam.
ex.zh: 電話在不該響的時候響了，就在考試進行到一半時。

root.note: 風向不利於進港的 → 時機不對的

senses.en: to ask for information
to investigate

ex.en: I called the hotel to inquire about room prices.
ex.zh: 我打電話到飯店詢問房價。

root.note: 探問進去 → 詢問
